scorekit.description: Deterministic music compiler CLI; ecosystem adjudication hub (docs/roadmap.md). Owns this workspace manifest and scripts/workspace.py.

scorebench.description: Agent-native desktop workbench (Tauri 2 + Svelte 5). Consumes scorekit strictly as a subprocess via --json; never links or parses human output.

scorebench-samples.description: Public sample gallery and reproducible capability corpus for scorebench/scorekit regression catching.

scoredata-forge.description: Deterministic CC0 SFZ sample-library foundry. Output-only coupling: never imports scorekit; its builds enter ScoreData like any downloaded library.

ScoreData.description: Local, versioned sound-source inventory (libraries, archives, manifests, certified profiles). Not a git repo; large binary payloads.
ScoreData.provisioning: Provision manually per its README: libraries enter via incoming/ -> manifest + checksums -> catalog -> scorekit profile check.
